about: Golden Set version 2 (ADR 0012, docs/golden-set.md): version 1's cases other than the brief's, rewritten with one-claim Required Facts in two tiers, and new cases, each recording its split. Version 1 (golden_set.json) stays unchanged as a record.
split_rule: Each case records its split, and no case ever moves. Version 1's cases rewritten here keep their ids and are dev. New cases are pending until all of them exist; then the 20 whose ids have the lowest SHA-256 hex digests (UTF-8) are holdout and the rest dev. A run refuses while any case is pending.

cases.question: What legal proceedings does Apple disclose in its latest Filings?

cases.question: And the oil majors?

history.content: What regulatory risks do the major pharmaceutical companies face, and how are they addressing them?

The major pharmaceutical companies (AbbVie, Johnson & Johnson, Eli Lilly, Merck and Pfizer, from the Sector table's Pharmaceuticals and Biotechnology industries) all describe drug pricing pressure from the Inflation Reduction Act. Merck expects U.S. Keytruda sales to decline from January 2028 under government pricing (MRK_10-K_2024-12-31, Risk Factors), and Eli Lilly announced preliminary voluntary pricing agreements with the U.S. government in November 2025 (LLY_10-K_2025-12-31, Risk Factors). AbbVie's, Merck's and Pfizer's latest 10-Ks are for FY2024; J&J's and Lilly's are for FY2025.
